tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all active API categories with the number of published APIs in each. Use to populate a category filter or browse by topic.

tools.name: get_category_apis
tools.description: List published APIs in a category by slug (e.g. 'weather', 'finance'). Paginated. Use list_categories first to get a category slug.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Get full detail for one API by slug or id, including health, metadata, verification, and warnings. Use after browsing a category to drill in.

tools.name: get_alternatives
tools.description: Find alternative APIs similar to a given API id — prefers same category, falls back to same API type. limit must be 2 or 3 (default 3).

tools.name: check_health
tools.description: Trigger (or return cached) a health check for one API. Returns CACHED within cooldown, or QUEUED with a poll URL. Rate-limited per device.

tools.name: get_api_trust_score
tools.description: Get the Reqistry trust score for one API by id or slug. Score covers uptime, response time, docs quality, auth clarity, CORS, pricing clarity, freshness, and OpenAPI availability.

tools.name: compare_apis
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 APIs side-by-side by id or slug. Returns auth, pricing, rate limits, SDKs, response time, CORS, verification, OpenAPI, and trust scores.

tools.name: assess_api_production_safety
tools.description: Assess whether an API looks production-safe using Reqistry trust score, health, docs, auth, pricing, CORS, and OpenAPI signals.

tools.name: suggest_alternatives
tools.description: Suggest healthier alternatives to a weak or dead API. Uses the same category/type matching as Reqistry alternatives.

tools.name: get_change_feed
tools.description: Read recent Reqistry API change events: pricing changes, docs moves, OpenAPI changes, health degradation/recovery, and trust-score changes.

tools.name: get_use_case_collections
tools.description: Get curated use-case packs such as finance dashboards, free AI APIs, travel apps, and no-auth prototype APIs.

tools.name: submit_api
tools.description: Submit a new API for review. Creates a 'pending' submission (not immediately published). At least name or link required. Email optional.

tools.name: recommend_apis
tools.description: Get recommended APIs — personalized when the device has bookmarks, otherwise random picks. Optional limit (max 50).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_health, get_change_feed · Public sink: submit_api.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_health, get_change_feed · Public sink: submit_api

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
